competitive_advantage.rationale: Mounjaro及Zepbound專利產品、臨床資料及製造規模支持競爭優勢；需監測同類藥品競爭與降價。

structural_growth_runway.rationale: Q2營收年增48%，全球銷量成長60%；retatrutide第三期資料及產能投資提供成長來源，不將臨床或核准結果視為保證。

valuation.rationale: Mounjaro and Zepbound support high growth, while pricing, launch investment and acquisition execution constrain distributable earnings.
